title: Sleep cycles

data.source: PhysioNet Sleep-EDF Expanded, sleep cassette hypnograms, first 40 nights (Kemp et al. 2000)
data.licence: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0

prediction: Within a night, a longer REM episode is followed by a longer wait before the next REM episode: correlation above zero with one-sided p below 0.05 against shuffles within nights.
baseline: A clock with no carry-over: the same nights with REM lengths shuffled within each night.
why: A longer REM episode was not followed by a longer wait. In these 40 nights there is no sign that REM spends a count that then has to refill.
